title: Episode About the Battle at Anandpur Sahib

blocks.text: The siege tightened around Anandpur from multiple sides, with roads blocked and grain, fodder, and movement cut off until the whole place began to choke under encirclement. (17–20)
People plead with the Guru for survival, but he answers with confidence in the Creator and with words meant to hold morale even as deprivation worsens. (21–22)
Others press for negotiated escape under promises from the hill chiefs, and the Guru warns that such pledges are treacherous and should not be trusted lightly. (23–25)
